Hi John — thanks for the clear list. High-level summary below and I'll attach the requested exports. Longer playbook and SOC2 mapping are linked.

Scan cadence and ownership:
- Container image scans: nightly (automated build pipeline + third-party scanner: thirdparty-scanner@secscan.io). Owner: Platform Security (Mina Haddad).
- Host/VM network vulnerability scans: weekly (scheduled Nessus-style scans, external retention 90 days). Owner: Infra Ops (Laura Bennett).
- Dependency/OSS composition scans (SCA): on-push for builds + weekly full repo sweep. Owner: App Security.

Monthly "sweep" windows (summary cadence):
- First week: full repository SCA rollup and high-level exec summary.
- Third week: deep sweep — triage and backfill of previously deferred findings, remediation window starts the following Monday.

CVE remediation SLAs (target windows):
- Critical (active exploit / RCE): 72 hours to mitigation or compensating controls; 7 days to full remediation where possible.
- High: 14 calendar days to mitigation plan and prioritized fix in next scheduled sweep.
- Medium: 90 calendar days for remediation or documented acceptance if risk compensations exist.
- Low: risk-accepted or scheduled to normal maintenance cycle (6-12 months).

Exceptions and blackout windows:
- For Dedicated customer infra with change blackouts we document exceptions in the remediation tracker and provide compensating controls; exceptions require Infra Ops + Platform Security approval and are reviewed weekly.

Artifacts attached / links:
- 2026-10-31-container-scan-summary.csv (redacted image IDs)
- remediation-tracker-redwood-202611.xlsx (filtered view, internal IDs removed)
- vm-process-playbook.pdf (internal playbook; mapping to SIG/SOC2 sections included)
- Drive folder with SOC2/SIG evidence: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-redwood-vm-evidence

We can also provide a short attestation email for your record each quarter summarizing SLA performance (uptime of scans, % closed within SLA). Let me know if you need that as a signed PDF.

Best,
Monica Patel
